visualCharacteristics.purpose: flight search form (trip type, travellers, nonstop, origin/destination autocomplete, dates) that hands the search off to shop.lufthansa.com
traits: white search panel above the stage
options row (trip type select, traveller summary, nonstop checkbox) over a fields row
origin and destination inputs with a swap button between
date range and a primary submit button on one line at desktop

contentPattern.structure: 2 columns, label | value. Rows (all optional): Tabs | Flights; Trip types | Round trip, One way (first = round trip, second = one way); Default trip type | Round trip; Traveller label | Economy, 1 Traveller; Nonstop label | Nonstop only; From label | From; Default origin | Frankfurt (FRA) or FRA (omitted: the locale home airport); Default destination | code; To label | To; Date label | Departure - return (split at ' - ' into the two date labels); Date error | Please provide travel date(s); Submit label | Search flights; Where we fly | link; Cabin | E; Adults | 1. Overridable UI rows: Trip type label, Swap label, Departure label, Return label, Origin error, Destination error, No results label. UI strings have built-in English and German defaults chosen by the page language; any can be overridden with a row of the same name

usage: Homepage and booking hub pages: the primary flight search above the stage.
reuseGuidance: Reuse unchanged on every template and locale; change only the authored labels. Airport suggestions and names come from /service/api via lhFetch; request and response mapping sit at the top of flight-search.js, the shop handoff parameters in buildShopHandoffUrl.
